model:
tff('declare_$i1',type,'fmb_$i_1':$i).
tff('declare_$i2',type,'fmb_$i_2':$i).
tff('finite_domain_$i',axiom,
      ! [X:$i] : (
         X = 'fmb_$i_1' | X = 'fmb_$i_2'
      ) ).

tff('distinct_domain_$i',axiom,
         'fmb_$i_1' != 'fmb_$i_2'
).

tff(declare_zero,type,zero:$i).
tff(zero_definition,axiom,zero = 'fmb_$i_1').
tff(declare_one,type,one:$i).
tff(one_definition,axiom,one = 'fmb_$i_2').
tff(declare_block010,type,block010:$i).
tff(block010_definition,axiom,block010 = 'fmb_$i_1').
tff(declare_block101,type,block101:$i).
tff(block101_definition,axiom,block101 = 'fmb_$i_2').
tff(declare_summary,type,summary: ($i) > $i).
tff(function_summary,axiom,
           summary('fmb_$i_1') = 'fmb_$i_1'
         & summary('fmb_$i_2') = 'fmb_$i_1'

).

tff(declare_extend,type,extend: ($i * $i) > $i).
tff(function_extend,axiom,
           extend('fmb_$i_1','fmb_$i_1') = 'fmb_$i_1'
         & extend('fmb_$i_1','fmb_$i_2') = 'fmb_$i_2'
         & extend('fmb_$i_2','fmb_$i_1') = 'fmb_$i_2'
         & extend('fmb_$i_2','fmb_$i_2') = 'fmb_$i_1'

).
